graph_features.support_order: Sort the four actual fixed interface groups by master_node_id ascending, exactly as original25 support-ref distance slots19:23 in tools/prepare_deepjeb.py:97. Store each CAD's master IDs and physical coordinates; do not replace this with coordinate lexicographic order.

graph_features.GRID_alignment: Reuse verified coordinate matching to H5 vertex order with explicit match tolerance and member mapping evidence. Never assume nodeID-1 or CSV row order.
graph_features.graph: Original quadratic TETRA10 topology;12 undirected corner-to-midside subedges per cell, deduplicated into CSR. No remeshing/resampling.
graph_features.weights: Physical endpoint Euclidean edge length in mm divided by that CAD's existing characteristic_length_mm L. Use physical coordinates and FP64 distance arithmetic; no target-derived weighting.
graph_features.distance: graph: multi-source Dijkstra minimum edge-path distance to any member. euclidean: minimum physical Euclidean distance to any member of exactly the same source group. Both yield five active channels for every original FEM node in the same prepared order and use the same L.
graph_features.Euclidean_control: Use the same actual four support-member groups and loaded-member group; original25 slots19:23 are distances to reference masters and cannot substitute for this matched nearest-member distance5.
graph_features.normalization: Divide edge lengths by existing L only. No fitted scale, clipping, log transform, extra strength, or hyperparameter sweep.
graph_features.cache: Two float32[N,5] arrays for Euclidean-interface and mesh-edge-path distance, plus original-node/xyz/order hashes,L,the identical group master/member mapping,source identities,graph edge/component counts and finite/reachability checks; one cache per CAD reused across known loads.
graph_features.cache_owner_handoff: hashgrid_impl prepares tools/prepare_graph_context.py separately after root authorization; this note neither creates nor verifies its45 caches.
graph_features.acceptance: All45 caches must match original query order and five exact source groups, contain only finite nonnegative distances, and have no unresolved disconnected queries. Report failure instead of filling inf with0. Verify d_graph is not below same-group nearest Euclidean distance except declared arithmetic tolerance.
graph_features.limits: This is distance in the fixed tetrahedral edge graph, not elasticity stiffness, exact continuous geodesic, a constitutive law, or remeshing-invariant geometry. Group union omits DOF/weights/patch topology; the graph omits material-dependent stiffness.
